name: Pasquale Prostamo
evidence: HIS DEATH ACT, AND THE PROOF OF THE DESCENT. Pizzo, Morti 1829, atto 7: PASQUALE PROSTAMO, MARINARO, VEDOVO DI CATERINA MAJO, born at Pizzo, of the Castello quarter, died there on 13 January 1829. THE DESCENT IS NO LONGER AN ASSERTION: a certified extract of this very act was filed in Domenico Prostamo's marriage papers at Briatico in June 1849 as the groom's «fede di morte dell'AVO PATERNO» — so Pasquale was Domenico's paternal grandfather, which is to say ANTONINO's father. TWO DOCUMENTS DISAGREE ABOUT HIS AGE: the original register says SETTANTACINQUE (75, born c. 1753); the chancery's own certified copy of 1849 says SESSANTACINQUE (65, born c. 1763). This archive carries the original's figure. His own parents' lines in the act are blank, and he married before civil registration began in 1809, so the generation above him is probably not reachable online at all.

name: Antonino Prostamo
evidence: NAMED IN THREE DOCUMENTS AND DEAD IN A FOURTH. He declares his son's birth at Pizzo on 2 April 1814, «ANTONINO PROSTAMO di anni TRENTADUE, di professione MARINARO, domiciliato alle Moli», with his «legittima moglie MARIA FRAGALÀ di anni ventisette». He is «il fu Antonino» in the Pizzo marriage banns of April 1849 and in his son's Briatico marriage act of 14 June 1849. AND HE DIED IN THE CHOLERA: Pizzo's separate REGISTER OF CHOLERA DEATHS for 1837, atto 327 — «A dì 31 Dicembre anno milleottocento trentasette ad ore due di notte è morto ANTONINO PROSTAMO di anni 56, marinaro, domiciliato alla Ripa della Marinella, marito di MARIA FRAGALÀ del Pizzo». Fifty-six on the last night of 1837 and thirty-two in April 1814 both put his birth about 1781; the family tree says 1785.

name: Domenico Prostamo
evidence: BIRTH DATE NOW EXACT, AND HE WAS REGISTERED UNDER ANOTHER NAME. Pizzo, Nati 1814, atto 285: born at ore diciotto on 2 APRIL 1814 in his father's house «alle Moli», to ANTONINO PROSTAMO, 32, marinaro, and MARIA FRAGALÀ, 27 — and christened in the register ANTONIO Prostamo. On 14 June 1849, the morning of his wedding, he and four witnesses swore an ATTO DI NOTORIETÀ before the sindaco of Briatico that the man entered in the 1814 register as Antonio «chiamasi effettivamente DOMENICO PROSTAMO, e questo è stato sempre il suo effettivo nome». In that act he is «figlio del fu Antonino, di anni TRENTACINQUE» — thirty-five, where his marriage act the same day says thirty-six. He married GIOVANNA VENTRICE, 21, of Briatico. The family tree's 1820 is six years out.

name: Alfonso Prostamo
evidence: Aged 24 in January 1886 and 25 in May 1887, so born about 1862, not 1858 as the tree says. A MARINARO — a sailor, not a contadino. Married Caterina Melluso, 21, daughter of Leone Melluso, on 21 May 1887 at Briatico.
